answer: Uptime beats cleverness. A key unlocks its payout only after 30 days of continuous availability, and its fingerprint ties it to one model build. Ten clones on one build, one fingerprint, one unlock clock. A comet of keys registered in one night all start at day 0 and all need 30 days, so the nebula of fresh registrations pays nothing this month and 1,000 keys cost 1,000 x 30 days of hosting before the first credit. The delta in month two is the only number that matters.
